-- Settings: prepared statements ON

SELECT
  j.id,
  j.role_title,
  c.name AS company_name,
  COALESCE(j.location_city || ', ' || j.location_state::text, j.location_city, 'Remote/Unknown') AS location_display,
  j.salary_text,
  j.status,
  j.score_band,
  j.ai_score,
  j.entity_type,
  j.recommended_service,
  j.recommended_first_action,
  j.pain_hypothesis,
  j.outreach_angle,
  j.discovered_at,
  j.claimed_by,
  j.claimed_at,
  j.notes,
  j.followup_notes,
  j.outcome_notes,
  j.notes_updated_at,
  j.followup_notes_updated_at,
  j.outcome_notes_updated_at,
  u.display_name AS claimed_by_name,
  CASE
    WHEN j.claimed_by IS NULL THEN 'unclaimed'
    WHEN j.claimed_by = {{ appsmith.user.email }}::citext THEN 'mine'
    ELSE 'claimed_other'
  END AS claim_status,
  CASE j.score_band::text
    WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'hot'      THEN 2
    WHEN 'warm'     THEN 3
    WHEN 'low'      THEN 4
    WHEN 'unscored' THEN 5
    WHEN 'ignore'   THEN 6
    ELSE 99
  END AS score_rank,
  ({{ appsmith.user.email }}::citext = ANY(j.dismissed_by)) AS hidden_by_me
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id
LEFT JOIN users u     ON u.email = j.claimed_by
WHERE
  CASE COALESCE({{ selectPriorityFilter.selectedOptionValue || 'priority' }}, 'priority')
    WHEN 'priority' THEN j.score_band::text IN ('critical', 'hot')
    WHEN 'extended' THEN j.score_band::text IN ('warm', 'low', 'unscored', 'ignore')
    WHEN 'all'      THEN TRUE
    ELSE TRUE
  END
  AND j.status NOT IN ('placed', 'closed_lost', 'rejected')
  AND (
    {{ toggleShowHidden?.isSwitchedOn ?? false }} = true
    OR NOT ({{ appsmith.user.email }}::citext = ANY(j.dismissed_by))
  )
ORDER BY score_rank ASC, j.discovered_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

        c.years_experience::text,

        CASE WHEN c.location_text ILIKE '%' || COALESCE((SELECT location_state FROM job)::text, '') || '%' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE 
            WHEN (SELECT salary_max_aud FROM job) IS NOT NULL 
            AND c.salary_expectation::numeric <= (SELECT salary_max_aud FROM job) THEN 20

SELECT
    ss.id AS session_id,
    ss.status,
    ss.scheduled_at,
    ss.notes,
    ss.no_answer_count,
    ss.screener_email,
    c.id AS candidate_id,
    c.full_name AS candidate_name,
    c.phone,
    c.email AS candidate_email,
    c.linkedin_url,
    c.headline,
    c.discipline::text AS candidate_discipline,
    c.years_experience::text,
    c.strengths,
    c.availability_signal,
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.role_title,
    j.discipline AS job_discipline,
    j.location_city,
    j.location_state,
    j.employee_instruction,
    j.pain_hypothesis,
    comp.name AS company_name,
    j.inferred_client_name,
    m.ai_compatibility_score,
    m.ai_match_reasoning,
    m.ai_match_concerns
FROM screening_sessions ss
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = ss.candidate_id
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = ss.job_id
LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = j.company_id
LEFT JOIN candidate_job_matches m ON m.id = ss.match_id
WHERE ss.id = '{{ appsmith.store.activeSessionId }}'::uuid;

SELECT
    id,
    question_number,
    question_text,
    expected_answer,
    poor_answer_indicators,
    difficulty,
    screener_notes,
    quick_score,
    ai_score,
    ai_verdict
FROM screening_responses
WHERE session_id = '{{ appsmith.store.activeSessionId }}'::uuid
ORDER BY question_number ASC;

UPDATE screening_responses
SET screener_notes = NULLIF(TRIM('{{ appsmith.store.currentQuestionNotes.replaceAll("''", "''''") }}'), ''),
    quick_score = {{ appsmith.store.currentQuestionScore ?? 'NULL' }},
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = '{{ appsmith.store.currentResponseId }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, screener_notes, quick_score;

UPDATE screening_sessions
SET status = 'rescheduled',
    scheduled_at = NULL,
    no_answer_count = no_answer_count + 1,
    notes = CASE
        WHEN notes IS NULL THEN '{{ appsmith.store.noAnswerNote.replaceAll("''", "''''") }}'
        ELSE notes || E'\n' || '{{ appsmith.store.noAnswerNote.replaceAll("''", "''''") }}'
    END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = '{{ appsmith.store.activeSessionId }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, status;

UPDATE candidate_job_matches
SET status = 'pending_screen',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT match_id FROM screening_sessions
    WHERE id = '{{ appsmith.store.activeSessionId }}'::uuid
)
RETURNING id, status;

UPDATE screening_sessions
SET scheduled_at = '{{ appsmith.store.rescheduleDate }}'::timestamptz,
    status = 'scheduled',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = '{{ appsmith.store.activeSessionId }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, scheduled_at;
